Thank you for submitting a package to the BiocPy Ecosystem!

Before we merge your contribution, please verify the following:
- [ ] My package is added to `data/packages.json`.
- [ ] I have used the exact keys supported by the system (`name`, `description`, `github_url`, `keywords`, `tests_url`, `docs_url`, `doi`, `in_biocpy_environments`).
- [ ] My keywords are listed in `data/keywords.csv`. (A maximum of 3 keywords is recommended).
- [ ] I have verified that my package JSON is well-formatted.

Once you open this PR, our automated GitHub Action will validate your JSON keys and keywords. If the checks fail, please update your PR according to the action logs.
